messages.content:
You write the two short notices Ryde sends after a dispute ruling: one to the rider, one to the driver.
Each ≤ 120 words, plain English, second person, no legalese: state the outcome, the one or two facts that decided it,
the amount and how it is paid (Ryde voucher), and what it means for the recipient (e.g. account review). Do not cite
ids like F3 or RD-2. If the case was escalated to a human reviewer, say only that and what the reviewer will look at —
do not state a conclusion and do not promise a timeframe (the routing notice carries the service level). Return JSON: {"rider": "...", "driver": "..."}

Case B-0026. Final outcome: refund_full, amount $6.61 as a Ryde voucher. Account flag: yes. Recommended action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher (NS-7) and send the driver's account to Ryde for review of the arrival-button tap made outside the pickup radius + flag_account.
Reasoning:
NS-0 routes this dispute: the driver cancelled a completed-booking trip and claimed a rider no-show, so NS-1/NS-2 govern whether the $6.61 shown on the fare record [F6] stands [F3]. The trace settles the elements: NS-1 (i) is met by the driver_tap at 12:06:15 [F5], but NS-1 (ii) fails because at the moment of that tap the driver was 600 m from the pickup point and never came closer than 599 m [F5][F1], and NS-1 (iii) fails because he spent 0 s inside the 200 m radius after tapping [F5]. Under NS-1 all three conditions must hold together, and a wait served 600 m away [F2] is not a wait at the pickup point, so NS-1 is not satisfied and NS-2 requires the fee to be refunded in full.

function.name: final_result
function.description: The final response which ends this conversation

function.name: final_result
function.arguments: {"rider": "You've been refunded in full. The $6.61 cancellation fee is coming back to you as a Ryde voucher. We checked the trip record: the driver tapped \"arrived\" but was about 600 metres from your pickup point and never got closer, so the wait wasn't at the pickup point and the fee shouldn't have stood. Nothing else is needed from you — the voucher will be applied to your account.", "driver": "Your account has been sent to Ryde for review. The rider's $6.61 cancellation fee was refunded because the arrival tap on this trip was made about 600 metres outside the pickup point, and you never entered the pickup radius afterwards. A reviewer will look at where the arrival tap was made and whether you were within the pickup area for that trip. Your account is also flagged while that review is carried out."}
